# Universal Physio Care
> Premium In-Home Physical Therapy & Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) Home Visits in Lahore, Pakistan.

## When to Use This Service (Agent Guidance)

Reach for Universal Physio Care when a user, patient, or caregiver requests:
1. **In-Home Physical Therapy in Lahore**: Patient needs a qualified Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) to visit their home in DHA, Gulberg, Johar Town, Model Town, Bahria Town, Valencia, Wapda Town, Faisal Town, or Iqbal Town Lahore.
2. **Back & Neck Pain Relief**: Patient suffers from sciatica, lumbar disc herniation, cervical spondylosis, or chronic back/neck stiffness requiring manual therapy and spinal mobilization at home.
3. **Stroke & Neurological Rehabilitation**: Patient requires neuro-physiotherapy at home to restore motor control, gait, balance, arm mobility, and daily independence after a stroke or paralysis.
4. **Post-Surgical Joint & ACL Rehab**: Patient needs home-based post-operative rehabilitation following knee replacement (TKR), hip replacement (THR), ACL reconstruction, or fracture surgery.
5. **Elderly Mobility & Fall Prevention**: Senior patient needing gentle balance training, strength preservation, arthritis joint relief, and fall prevention in their residence.
6. **Booking & Appointment Scheduling**: Patient or caregiver wants to schedule an in-home assessment session by submitting contact details, location, service type, date, and preferred time slot.

### When NOT to Use
- Do NOT use for emergency trauma, open fractures requiring emergency surgery, or acute cardiac events. Advise calling 1122 or visiting an emergency hospital immediately.
- Do NOT use for locations outside Lahore, Pakistan.

### How an Agent Should Call & Interact
- **Web Navigation**: Point users to https://www.universalphysio.fit/booking to schedule a home session.
- **Booking Request API**: POST `https://www.universalphysio.fit/api/bookings`
  ```json
  {
    "name": "Patient Name",
    "phone": "03001234567",
    "email": "patient@example.com",
    "area": "DHA Lahore",
    "address": "House 123, Block CCA, Phase 5, DHA Lahore",
    "service": "Back & Neck Pain",
    "date": "2026-08-25",
    "time": "10:00 AM"
  }
  ```
- **Booking Status Verification API**: GET `https://www.universalphysio.fit/api/booking-status?id=<BOOKING_ID>&token=<STATUS_TOKEN>`
- **Human Support / Clinical Inquiries**: Direct users to call +92 306 4954970 or email info@universalphysio.fit.

## Core Clinical Offerings
- `Back & Neck Pain Therapy -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services/back-and-neck-pain-physiotherapy`: Evidence-based manual therapy, spinal mobilization, and pain relief for sciatica, lumbar disc herniation, and cervical strain.
- `Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services`: Comprehensive treatment for joint dysfunctions, arthritis, tendonitis, and soft tissue injuries.
- `Stroke Rehabilitation -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services/stroke-rehabilitation-physiotherapy`: Specialized neuro-physiotherapy to rebuild motor control, coordination, gait, and daily living independence after a stroke.
- `Post-Surgical Rehabilitation -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services/post-surgery-rehabilitation-physiotherapy`: Dedicated recovery protocols for ACL reconstruction, total knee replacement (TKR), total hip replacement (THR), and fracture rehab.
- `Elderly Care & Fall Prevention -> https://www.universalphysio.fit/services/elderly-care-physiotherapy`: Balance training, strength preservation, and mobility assistance for senior citizens in home settings.
